# Endless Styles Festival

> Endless Styles Festival is a four-day urban dance, music, and cultural exchange festival in Waikīkī, Hawaiʻi.

## 2027 Festival

- Dates: May 13–16, 2027
- Location: Waikīkī, Hawaiʻi
- Format: Four days of dance, music, workshops, battles, cyphers, and community programming
- Featured formats: Breaking 2v2, Open Styles 1v1, Last Man Standing, workshops, cyphers, and after-parties
- Community event: Free
- Website: https://www.endlessstyles.org/
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/endlessstylesfestival
- Contact: Endlessstylesfestival@gmail.com

## About

Endless Styles Festival connects Hawaiʻi's local creative community with dancers and culture from around the world. The festival centers Hip Hop culture, freestyle dance, cultural exchange, youth empowerment, and community.

## Organizers

- Lino Delgado / DJ Leanskee
- Boaz Rosen / Boseph

## Sponsorship

Partnership and sponsorship opportunities are available through the festival website and email contact.
